title: stock — replenishment (orderpoint, procurement rule, make-to-order)
gap_addressed: stock.warehouse.orderpoint never studied at L3 in prior passes
key_findings: stock.warehouse.orderpoint model is defined in stock/models/stock_orderpoint.py at line 21, NOT in stock_warehouse_orderpoint.py (file was renamed in v19)
The scheduler entry point is stock.rule.run_scheduler (line 734 in stock_rule.py), which delegates to _run_scheduler_tasks
Orderpoint scheduler domain restricts to trigger='auto' and active products only (stock_rule.py:747)
MTO route is a global shared route (stock.route_warehouse0_mto) created/linked via _find_or_create_global_route in stock_warehouse.py:462
MTO pull rule has procure_method='make_to_order' and action='pull' (stock_warehouse.py:457,459)
Pull rule creates stock.move records via sudo with immediate _action_confirm() triggering chained rules (stock_rule.py:315-317)
rule-action dispatch is dynamic: handler method name constructed as _run_{action} (stock_rule.py:496-498)
pull_push action always resolved to 'pull' for procurement dispatch (stock_rule.py:489)
_quantity_in_progress() is an override point returning 0 in base; purchase module overrides to return pending PO quantities
Snoozed orderpoints: only manual-trigger rules can be snoozed; auto-trigger rules must be archived instead
mts_else_mto: initial move created with make_to_stock; availability checked at assignment stage (stock_rule.py:305-307)
